status: Fixed before downloading or inspecting any 2025-11-16..18 data.
rule: Flag a first-appearance transaction when its score is at or above the (1-q) quantile of the scores of the previous W first-appearance transactions with strictly earlier timestamps. Scores only; no outcomes.
selection: Chosen in development on four already-inspected test days (docs/results/solana_adaptive_alert_development.json): the setting whose HOMIE-minus-baseline recall gap had a 95% interval above zero on the most days (3 of 4). q=0.05, W=500 is reported as secondary.
models: Identity-controlled baseline and HOMIE, settings unchanged.
primary_endpoints: E1 stability: flag rate on test first appearances within 0.08-0.12 for both models.
E2 benefit: HOMIE recall minus baseline recall > 0 with 95% paired one-hour block bootstrap interval (500 draws, seed 42) entirely above zero.

fresh_window.selection: Three consecutive dates never used in the project. Shard index = int(sha256(f'{date}|homie-adaptive-fresh'),16) mod file count; row group 0.

also_reported: The identity-controlled first-appearance AP comparison on this window (main research endpoint).
reporting: Results retained regardless of direction; fresh evaluation runs once.
